title: Freestanding 4-Arm Swing Towel Stand 49-Inch Solid Brass Assorted Free Standing Accessorie | Allied Brass
short_title: Assorted Free Standing Accessorie 4-Arm Towel Stand | Allied Brass
description:
Add flexible towel storage without drilling with this freestanding 4-arm swing towel stand, crafted from solid brass and built around a heavy base for stability.

Highlights:
- Four pivoting swing arms help maximize hanging space and separate towels for faster drying
- Freestanding design requires no wall mounting for easy placement in the bathroom
- Solid brass construction is designed to resist rust and corrosion
- Heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping; felt pad helps protect floors
- Multiple designer finish options available to coordinate with other pieces

Specs:
- Collection: Soho Collection
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Freestanding
- Overall size: 12-Inch L x 9.25-Inch W x 49-Inch H
- Diameter: 1-Inch
- Weight capacity: 20 lb
- Product weight: 13.6 lb
- Assembly required: Yes
- Included: Towel stand
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Towel stand has 4 pivoting arms so that you can maximize your space. Large base is weighted to help prevent tipping. Towel stand is made of the finest solid brass materials so that it will not rust or corrode and is provided with one of our designer lifetime finishes.
